en: Rara has finished her dinner. Now it is time to brush her teeth.
Dad puts a tiny blob of toothpaste on the brush, as small as a pea.
Brush the top teeth. Swish, swish, swish!
Brush the bottom teeth. Swish, swish, swish! And the back teeth too.
Spit it out. Ptuh! Rara smiles in the mirror. Clean and shiny!
id: Rara sudah selesai makan malam. Sekarang waktunya menyikat gigi.
Ayah menaruh pasta gigi sedikit saja di sikat, sebesar kacang polong.
Sikat gigi atas. Srek, srek, srek!
Sikat gigi bawah. Srek, srek, srek! Gigi belakang juga.
Buang busanya. Ptuh! Rara tersenyum di depan cermin. Bersih dan berkilau!

readAloudNotes.en: Rub your tummy and say 'mmm, dinner'.
readAloudNotes.id: Usap perut dan berkata 'hmm, makan malam'.

readAloudNotes.en: Show the size of a pea with your finger and thumb.
readAloudNotes.id: Tunjukkan ukuran kacang polong dengan jari telunjuk dan jempol.

readAloudNotes.en: Move a pretend brush over your top teeth.
readAloudNotes.id: Gerakkan sikat pura-pura di gigi atas.

readAloudNotes.en: Move it over your bottom teeth, then open wide to show the back.
readAloudNotes.id: Gerakkan di gigi bawah, lalu buka mulut lebar untuk menunjukkan gigi belakang.

readAloudNotes.en: Make a gentle 'ptuh' sound and give a big smile.

objectives.en: Listens to a story and sequences the steps of brushing teeth.
objectives.id: Mendengarkan cerita dan mengurutkan langkah menyikat gigi.

objectives.en: Knows that toothpaste is used in a small amount and spat out.
objectives.id: Tahu bahwa pasta gigi dipakai sedikit dan dibuang.

meaning.en: a paste we put on a toothbrush to clean teeth
push something out of your mouth
meaning.id: mengeluarkan busa atau air dari mulut

prompt.en: How much toothpaste did Dad use?
prompt.id: Berapa banyak pasta gigi yang dipakai Ayah?

en: a tiny blob the size of a pea

prompt.en: What did Rara do after brushing?
prompt.id: Apa yang Rara lakukan setelah menyikat gigi?

prompt.en: Why do we brush the back teeth too?
prompt.id: Mengapa gigi belakang juga harus disikat?

en: because front teeth do not matter

connection.en: Brushing twice a day with a little fluoride toothpaste helps keep teeth healthy.
connection.id: Menyikat gigi dua kali sehari dengan sedikit pasta gigi berfluoride membantu menjaga gigi tetap sehat.

discussionPrompts.en: When do you brush your teeth?
Can you show me how to brush the top teeth?
discussionPrompts.id: Bisakah kamu tunjukkan cara menyikat gigi atas?

offlineActivity.en: Brush teeth side by side tonight. The adult squeezes the toothpaste. Say 'top, bottom, back' as you go, then smile in the mirror together.
offlineActivity.id: Malam ini sikat gigi berdampingan. Orang dewasa yang menuang pasta gigi. Ucapkan 'atas, bawah, belakang' sambil menyikat, lalu tersenyum bersama di depan cermin.

factChecks.claim: Children aged about 3 to 6 should use a pea-sized amount of fluoride toothpaste.
Brushing twice a day helps prevent tooth decay.

safetyNotes.en: An adult puts the toothpaste on and helps with brushing; young children should spit the toothpaste out, not swallow it.
safetyNotes.id: Orang dewasa yang menaruh pasta gigi dan membantu menyikat; anak kecil perlu membuang pasta giginya, bukan menelannya.
